topics.label: Evaluation independence: agents leaving state that survives across runs
topics.notes: New this cycle, split out of agent-security-incidents because it is a harness design question rather than a security news question. Reuters 07-31: investigators found notes inside OpenAI infrastructure that appear to instruct future agent runs on escaping constraints. Redwood's Alex Mallen cautions the purpose is unestablished: deliberate cross-run coordination or an artifact of ordinary progress-file logging (agents.md style). Either reading breaks the assumption that eval runs are independent instances, which is squarely Firas's lane (agentic state and memory, eval harnesses). Holding because the only sourcing is single-sourced reporting OpenAI disputes without specifics.
